name: Trade 9
definition: Details of the foreign exchange trade including spot\forward\NDF\swap that is confirmed.

TradeIdentification.name: Trade Identification
TradeIdentification.definition: Unique reference identification assigned to the trade by the instructing party. This reference will be used throughout the trade life cycle to identify the particular trade.

TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Specifies the date on which the trade was executed.

TradingCurrency.name: Trading Currency
TradingCurrency.definition: Specifies the ISO code of the trade currency.

SettlementCurrency.name: Settlement Currency
SettlementCurrency.definition: Settlement currency of the trade, agreed by both sides of the trade.

TradingMethod.name: Trading Method
TradingMethod.definition: Identifies the type of trading method.

TradingMode.name: Trading Mode
TradingMode.definition: Identifies the type of the trade mode.

ClearingMethod.name: Clearing Method
ClearingMethod.definition: Clearing method of the trade, agreed by both sides of the trade.

PlaceOfConfirmation.name: Place Of Confirmation
PlaceOfConfirmation.definition: Infrastructure where the trade confirmation will take place.

ForeignExchangeDetails.name: Foreign Exchange Details
ForeignExchangeDetails.definition: Provides details of the foreign exchange trade including Spot Forward and NDF.

SwapLeg.name: Swap Leg
SwapLeg.definition: Provides details about each leg of the multileg instrument (foreign exchange swap).

ProductIdentification.name: Product Identification
ProductIdentification.definition: Identification of the treasury trade product, as assigned under a formal or proprietary identification scheme.

AssociatedTradeReference.name: Associated Trade Reference
AssociatedTradeReference.definition: Some associated trade reference needs to be specified.

ForeignExchangeTradeProduct1Rule.definition: If ForeignExchangeTradeProduct is equal to 'FORW' (Foreign Exchange Forward) or 'NDFO' (Foreign Exchange Non Deliverable Forward) or 'SPOT' (Foreign Exchange Spot), then ForeignExchangeDetails must be present.

ForeignExchangeTradeProduct2Rule.definition: If Foreign Exchange Trade Product is equal to 'SWAP' (Foreign Exchange Swap), then SwapLeg must be present.

SwapLegRule.definition: If Foreign ExchangeTradeProduct is equal to 'SWAP' (Foreign Exchange Swap), then SwapLeg must be present.

FixingCurrencyAndFixingDateRule.definition: If ForeignExchangeTradeProduct is equal to value 'NDFO' (Foreign Exchange Non Deliverable Forward), then FixingCurrency and FixingDate must be present.

DeltaIndicatorRule.definition: If ForeignExchangeTradeProduct is equal to value 'SPOT' (Foreign Exchange Spot) or 'FORW' (Foreign Exchange Forward) , then DeltaIndicator must be present.

OptionIndicatorRule.definition: If ForeignExchangeTradeProduct is equal to value 'SPOT' (Foreign Exchange Spot), then OptionIndicator Must be present.

ForwardPointsRule.definition: If ForeignExchangeTradeProduct is equal to value 'NDFO' (Foreign Exchange Non Deliverable Forward) or 'FORW' (Foreign Exchange Forward), then ForwardPoints must be present.
